title: Number of Preschools that Offer Care Services Beyond 7.00 pm
what_it_is: Number of Preschools that Offer Care Services Beyond 7.00 pm

sections.label: Preschool full-day operating hours
sections.summary: Full-day preschools must operate 7.00 am to 7.00 pm on weekdays, and about 20 now operate beyond 7.00 pm, down from 40 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To cater to the needs of working parents, preschools providing full-day services are required to operate from 7.00 am to 7.00 pm on weekdays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Today, around 20 preschools operate beyond 7.00 pm on weekdays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This is a decrease from 40 preschools in 2021.

sections.label: Flexible work arrangements support
sections.summary: The Government worked with tripartite partners to encourage family-friendly employers, including launching the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA requests in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To support parents in accessing flexible work arrangements (FWA), the Government has worked closely with tripartite partners to encourage employers to provide a family-friendly work environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This includes the launch of the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA requests in 2024.

sections.label: Preschool extended hours business decision
sections.summary: Extending operating hours is left to preschool operators, who may charge for hours beyond 7.00 pm, and fewer preschools offering this may suggest no demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I do not think ECDA or the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will have a firm view either way on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I think the key thing here is that the decision to extend operating hours is a business decision that we have left to the preschool operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The preschools today are actually free to charge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: They are available and they are allowed to charge for the extra hours beyond 7.00 pm, depending.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The data over the last five years bears itself that the number of preschools offering that has actually come down, which may suggest that there may not be a demand for that.

sections.label: Long preschool hours and child outcomes
sections.summary: SG LEADS found that children staying in preschool beyond 40 hours and significantly beyond showed some impact on literacy and numeracy achievements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Another reason may also be because parents themselves recognise that it is important for them to spend enough time with their children and not leave the children in the preschools for too long a period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: This is the Singapore Longitudinal Early Development Study (SG LEADS) that found that the longer the children stayed in preschools, beyond 40 hours and significantly beyond, we start to observe that their literacy, their numeracy achievements do have some impact.
